lines.text: Hey! If that's not my favorite field researcher! How's it going out there, you already had to use my sword to scare off some wild animals?
Wait, you look different. What are these etchings on your forearm? What happened?

Why thank you, I actually had quite some use for the sword you gave me, but it wasn't wild animals. I had an encounter with a magical artefact and went into a place full of monsters. I died, but I survived.
What? You mean it's dangerous? Can I come with you?
No, we already tested it. Only I can enter. And you probably shouldn't anyway. The magic from the artefact seems to resurrect me if I die, but you don't have that advantage, as far as I remember.
Aww, unfair! Well, you make sure you bring anything interesting here, I want to see what you find in there
